# Modern Home Blinds

> Custom blinds and window coverings manufactured locally in Oakville, Ontario and installed across the Greater Toronto Area (GTA) — usually within one week. Family-run, with free in-home consultation and measurement.

Modern Home Blinds designs, manufactures, and installs made-to-measure window treatments for homes and condos throughout the GTA. Products are produced locally in Oakville (not imported), and every quote includes professional measurement and installation.

## Contact
- Phone: +1-647-673-1847
- Address: 2380 Wyecroft Rd, Unit 8, Oakville, ON, Canada
- Hours: Monday–Sunday, 9:00 AM – 6:00 PM
- Service area: Oakville, Milton, Mississauga, Brampton, Burlington, Toronto, North York, Etobicoke, Scarborough, Vaughan, Richmond Hill, Markham, Newmarket, Hamilton, Guelph, Kitchener, Waterloo, Cambridge and surrounding GTA.

## Products (per-window pricing, installed)
- [Zebra Blinds](https://www.modernhomeblinds.ca/zebra-blinds.html): Alternating sheer and solid fabric bands for adjustable light control. $190–$250 per window.
- [Roller Shades](https://www.modernhomeblinds.ca/roller-shades.html): Light-filtering, blackout, and solar-screen fabrics; clean, minimal look. $180–$240 per window.
- [Roman Shades](https://www.modernhomeblinds.ca/roman-shades.html): Soft fabric folds that stack neatly when raised. $350–$550 per window.
- [Custom Draperies & Sheers](https://www.modernhomeblinds.ca/draperies-sheers.html): Floor-to-ceiling, fully lined, sewn to exact dimensions. $350–$550 per window.
- [California Shutters](https://www.modernhomeblinds.ca/california-shutters.html): Classic adjustable-louvre panels for privacy and insulation. $200–$375 per window.
- [Soft Vertical Blinds](https://www.modernhomeblinds.ca/soft-vertical-blinds.html): Soft fabric vanes for patio doors and large windows. $350–$600 per window.
- [Silhouette Shades](https://www.modernhomeblinds.ca/silhouette-shades.html): Fabric vanes floating between sheers for diffused light. $250–$450 per window.
- [Cellular (Honeycomb) Shades](https://www.modernhomeblinds.ca/cellular-shades.html): Honeycomb cells for excellent insulation and energy efficiency. $250–$350 per window.
- [Motorized Blinds](https://www.modernhomeblinds.ca/motorized-blinds.html): Quiet motors with remote and Google Home / Alexa / Apple HomeKit support. +$200 per window.
- [Smart Film](https://www.modernhomeblinds.ca/smart-film.html): Switchable privacy glass film for instant frosting.

## Pricing notes
- Prices above are per window, installed (measurement + labour included).
- Condo / high-rise installations: +10%.
- Windows taller than 8 ft: +15%.
- Final pricing is confirmed after a free in-home measurement. HST not included.

## Key facts
- Manufactured locally in Oakville — not imported.
- Free in-home consultation and measurement.
- Typical installation within one week.
- Smart-home / motorization options available on most products.
